title: Glomar Challenger 海洋鑽探史
summary: 以Glomar Challenger海洋科學史比較早期紀錄與現代資料格式；重點是資料來源、採樣偏差與跨年代量測單位，不重現鑽探施工。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Glomar Challenger ocean-science history to compare early logs with modern data formats, focusing on provenance, sampling bias and units across eras rather than recreating drilling operations. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 對齊史料中的日期和時間基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Align dates and time conventions in archives: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 對齊史料中的日期和時間基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Align dates and time conventions in archives and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 對齊史料中的日期和時間基準：航段時間由距離除平均對地速度；調查、等待、轉彎與海況餘裕需分開。 本步以「航段時間與測站排程」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Align dates and time conventions in archives: Transit time is distance over mean ground speed; science stations, waiting, turns and weather allowance are separate. Use Transit time and station scheduling to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Glomar Challenger 海洋鑽探史實際規格：距離D=64.8 km、平均對地速度12 km/h。式 t=D/v，基準結果 5.4 h。條件：單段定平均速度，不提供實際航海路線或避碰建議。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Glomar Challenger ocean-drilling history: Distance D=64.8 km, mean ground speed 12 km/h. Formula t=D/v gives 5.4 h. Conditions: Single leg at constant mean speed; no actual navigation route or collision-avoidance advice.
steps.failure: 用最大航速規劃所有航段會低估任務時間；應使用具來源的平均情境。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Planning every leg at maximum speed understates mission time; use a documented mean scenario. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將移航與測站工作畫成甘特時間條，避免把工作時間又計入航段平均速度。 本案例另須檢查「對齊史料中的日期和時間基準」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Draw transit and station work on a timeline and avoid counting station time again in transit speed. Also check that Align dates and time conventions in archives and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：對齊史料中的日期和時間基準。在歷史航次表、岩芯目錄、紙本轉錄與品質檢核台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加距離10%，保持平均速度，重算移航時間並保留工作時段。 算式區的基準值為5.4，改變後為5.94 h。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Align dates and time conventions in archives. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Historical expedition table, core catalog, transcription and quality-check desk. Increase distance alone by 10%, retain mean speed and preserve station-work intervals. Baseline 5.4 changes to 5.94 h. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Glomar Challenger 海洋鑽探史」的「對齊史料中的日期和時間基準：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Align dates and time conventions in archives: Mechanism and observation” in “Glomar Challenger ocean-drilling history”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instructionEn: Distinguish mass and registration tonnage: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：辨識重量與登記噸位的差別。在歷史航次表、岩芯目錄、紙本轉錄與品質檢核台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為553.5，改變後為608.85 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Distinguish mass and registration tonnage. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Historical expedition table, core catalog, transcription and quality-check desk. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 553.5 changes to 608.85 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.
